errors.text: The intervention is only generic machine learning rather than a DFT-trained MTP replacing the liquid EAM reference together with FEP replacing thermodynamic integration.

The proposed mechanism concerns compositional screening through mixing enthalpy and configurational entropy, not efficient solid/liquid free-energy sampling enabled by low-variance MTP-to-DFT energy differences.
It does not specify treatment of both solid and dense-fluid phases or the electronic-excitation and solid-state short-range-order contributions needed for accurate transition thermodynamics.
The cited evidence addresses screening and stability of solid HEAs, not melting free energies, dense-fluid properties, MTP accuracy, or FEP convergence.
The falsification threshold is undefined and relies on sparse experimental data rather than a decisive FEP-versus-TI free-energy benchmark.
